rationale: The same 18 km advance of the 25th Airborne to Volokhiv Yar on 6 Sep 2022, from the same WaPo source.
Both report Ganchev's claim of eightfold Ukrainian superiority; they share a source.
Both say two spans fell on 8 Oct 2022; they share a Wikipedia source.
Zmiinyi Island area: about 0.20 km² by OSM vs about 16 ha by the Guardian; roughly consistent.
A-50U dead on 14 Jan 2024: 11 (ASN) vs 11–12 (FighterBomber).
The same claim of 20 April 2022 that about 500 border guards and police moved to Azovstal.
Both give the Sea Baby 2024 a range of 1,000+ km; they share a source.
The same Janovsky count of 102 Russian vehicles lost on 11 Sep 2022, which A also contains.
The same Magura V7 rating of sea state 3 and 1.25 m waves.
The same 600 km² flooded, 68% on the Russian-held side, from the same source.
Both describe the Channel 16 ultimatum to Zmiinyi repeated every 15–20 minutes; they share a source.
B's ABC and NPR figures (11 and 10.4 km²) back A's 11 km² for Azovstal; they share the ABC source.
Both describe mission 3 on 28 March 2022 in fog with 12 minutes on the ground, from the same source.
Two Russian milbloggers give more than 30 and 31 armoured vehicles lost in one Vuhledar assault.
The same UN figure of at least 50 POWs killed at Olenivka, from the same source.
The same two 500 kg bombs on the Mariupol theatre on 16 March 2022, from the same sources.
Both give two Raptor boats hit on 2 May 2022; they share a Janes source.
The same OSM-computed area of 0.2 km² for Zmiinyi Island.
The same Crimean Bridge length of about 19 km, from the same Wikipedia source.
The same ISW count of 60 KABs on Avdiivka on 17 Feb 2024; the topic-03 claim is canonical.
The OSM-summed 16.8 km of road and 18.1 km of rail is roughly consistent with the 19 km total, which includes approaches.
Russia's claim of 82 captured broadly matches the Ukrainian count of about 80 captured on Zmiinyi.
The OSM-computed route of 10.5 km is consistent with the civilians' walk of more than 10 km.
The same 3-hour closure of the Crimean Bridge (04:00–07:00) on 3 Jun 2025, from the same source.
Both give seven missions with 16 Mi-8s carrying 72 troops into Azovstal; they share sources.
Both put the 23 Feb 2024 A-50 kill at 200 km or more, measured from the front and from the launcher respectively.
The same 3 Feb 2023 ambush near Vuhledar (T-80 mined, two crew captured), from the same source.
Both give a 1,100 kg TNT-equivalent underwater charge on 3 Jun 2025; they share a source.
The same Ganchev claim of 8 times Ukrainian superiority on 12 Sep 2022, from the same source.
The same US statement of a dozen BTGs in Mariupol on 21 April 2022.
Ukraine's later figure of about 2,500 Azovstal prisoners corroborates Russia's claim of 2,439.
A 30–60-minute crossing to Krynky is consistent with a 40–50-minute route.
The same 18 km advance of the 25th Airborne on 6 Sep 2022, from the same WaPo source.
The same seizure of the Sapfir with 21 captives on 26 Feb 2022, from the same source.
The same Russian report of 10 missing and 23 injured on the Vasily Bekh.
The same Achilles claim of a 3 t pipeline demolition on 13 Dec 2025.
At least 30 abandoned armoured vehicles falls within the 20–40 range for Russian losses at Vuhledar.
Both report Ganchev's claim of eightfold Ukrainian superiority; they share a source.
The OSM-measured stretch of 10.5 km is consistent with the reported pipeline walk of about 10 km.
The same Moskva wreck location (about 80 nmi from Odesa, 45–50 m deep), from the same source.
